title: r2 minor SA: plugin-set lifetime per-clone-wiring mislabels a host-scoped enablement
description: Evidence: installed-artifact-manifest.md:79 vs its own note :84 — enablement lives at user scope (host granularity: a second clone on the same host inherits it), but the lifetime axis only offers tracked-or-per-clone. Disposition: extend the lifetime axis with a host-scope value, or state in the note why per-clone-wiring is the deliberate approximation. Owner: data-engineer. Validator: solution-architect.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: FIX LANDED (commit 026564ee, installed-artifact-manifest 0.3.0): the lifetime axis extends with host-wiring — wiring in host-scoped config that every clone on the host inherits — and the plugin-set entry takes it; prose states the axis addition. Terminal round re-verifies (validator: solution-architect).
